'''bmackin13 Han's So Freakin' Hot When He's Frozen''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bmackin13]]
* '''Published:''' 28 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Any Methods Necessary|ECC-D-anymethodsnecessary.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 CCT bmackin13 DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Boba Fett (V), Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (V), Slave I (V), Bane Malar (V), Djas Puhr (V), Prince Xizor (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Desilijic Tattoo (V), Despair (V), Jabba's Influence (V), He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V), Punishing One (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

FYI, this deck has yet to be played with.  I finally got around to posting this: a CCT deck with a slew of bounty hunters.

== Notes ==

* Blast Door Controls (v): no original-era (V) printing; dested the printed Premiere card.
* Original-era (V) slips: Boba Fett and his Blaster Rifle (VS6), Slave I (VS7), Bane Malar (VS7), Djas Puhr (VS2), Prince Xizor (VS7), Ability x3 (VS6), Desilijic Tattoo (VS5), Despair/Jabba's Influence/He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (VS6), Punishing One (VS7).
* Original-era printing corrected: Punishing One (V) (Virtual Set 7) -> Punishing One (V) (Virtual Set 5) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

here's my idea on a quick filp. Use Any Methods Necesssary to pull JP:Dungeon, Boba(v), Boba's Gun(v) and ship(v). Then, deploy boba and gun, take Jabbas Prize, deploy Despair(v) with Boba's gun's text, and deploy JP:Dungeon from hand. Deploy CC:Docking Day with CCT. don't move, just draw. hope you either got He's All yours Bounty Hunter(v) in first hand or draw. then, next turn, deploy Tatooine:DB, deploy any other people in your hand to Dungeon. Play HAYBH, move boba to dungeon. Next turn, deploy Audeince Chamber, Jabba from reserve deck, and move boba to AC. flip, and cannot be placed out of play due to despair.

There really isnt much more to this deck. Battle, retrieve, battle, retrive, capture.  I know my space fleet is weak.  I'm working on it.  If anyone has Maul's Sith Infiltrator or Mist Hunter BB, email me
